after.description: 等保三级 三权分立 mode. When ON: super-admin is unassignable, every role must carry a non-NULL sod_class, and the trg_sod_exclusion trigger enforces hard mutual exclusion across system/security/audit classes. Flip via the dedicated gated endpoint (security.write required); the OFF→ON flip runs admin_sod_precheck() in the same transaction. DEFAULT OFF — fully inert until deliberately enabled by a qualified security administrator.
Background-detected stale-thread / no-reply-in-3-days inbox nudges. Seeded OFF.
